metadata.brief: Посменный производственный учёт цеха CPS: ДР-1…СГ-1, OPC/LIMS, НСИ, мнемосхема, сменные и сводный отчёты

migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wm_dict_product (
  product_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  product_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  product_name VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL,
  product_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  unit VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
  parent_product_id INTEGER REFERENCES wm_dict_product(product_id),
  is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wm_dict_equipment (
  equipment_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  equipment_tag VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  equipment_name VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL,
  equipment_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  process_stage_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  line_no INTEGER,
  asutp_point_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  object_path VARCHAR(256),
  is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wm_dict_coefficient (
  coefficient_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  coefficient_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  coefficient_name VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL,
  value NUMERIC(18,6) NOT NULL,
  unit VARCHAR(32),
  ref_object_code VARCHAR(64),
  valid_from DATE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
  is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wm_dict_downtime_reason (
  reason_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  reason_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  reason_name VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL,
  reason_category VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wm_shift_calendar (
  shift_id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  work_date DATE NOT NULL,
  shift_no INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (shift_no BETWEEN 1 AND 3),
  started_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  ended_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(work_date, shift_no)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wm_integration_status (
  source_code VARCHAR(32) PRIMARY KEY,
  is_healthy BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  last_success_at TIMESTAMP,
  last_error TEXT,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wm_lims_quality (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  work_date DATE NOT NULL,
  shift_no INTEGER NOT NULL,
  sample_point VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  h2o_pct NUMERIC(10,3),
  sio2_pct NUMERIC(10,3),
  fe_pct NUMERIC(10,3),
  co_pct NUMERIC(10,3),
  source VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'LIMS',
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE(work_date, shift_no, sample_point)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wm_lims_bulk_density (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  work_date DATE NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  density_t_m3 NUMERIC(10,4) NOT NULL,
  source VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'LIMS',
  is_fallback BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wm_ore_receipt (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  work_date DATE NOT NULL,
  shift_no INTEGER NOT NULL,
  received_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  bucket_volume_m3 NUMERIC(10,3) NOT NULL,
  equipment_tag VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DR-1',
  created_by VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_wm_ore_receipt_shift ON wm_ore_receipt(work_date, shift_no);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wm_downtime (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  work_date DATE NOT NULL,
  shift_no INTEGER NOT NULL,
  equipment_tag VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  started_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  ended_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  reason_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  comment TEXT,
  duration_min INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS (GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ended_at - started_at))/60, 0)::INTEGER) STORED,
  created_by VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_wm_downtime_eq ON wm_downtime(equipment_tag, work_date, shift_no);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wm_shift_metric (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  work_date DATE NOT NULL,
  shift_no INTEGER NOT NULL,
  equipment_tag VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  metric_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  metric_value NUMERIC(18,6),
  unit VARCHAR(32),
  source VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual',
  is_overridden BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  updated_by VARCHAR(128),
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE(work_date, shift_no, equipment_tag, metric_code)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wm_flowmeter_hourly (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  work_date DATE NOT NULL,
  shift_no INTEGER NOT NULL,
  hour_index INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (hour_index BETWEEN 1 AND 8),
  equipment_tag VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SG-1',
  tag_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OUTPUT_FLOW',
  q_m3h NUMERIC(18,4) NOT NULL,
  captured_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE(work_date, shift_no, hour_index, equipment_tag, tag_code)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wm_equipment_tag_snapshot (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  equipment_tag VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  tag_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  tag_value NUMERIC(18,6),
  tag_text VARCHAR(256),
  captured_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_wm_tag_snap ON wm_equipment_tag_snapshot(equipment_tag, tag_code, captured_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wm_audit_log (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  entity_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  entity_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  action VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  actor_role VARCHAR(64),
  actor_name VARCHAR(128),
  payload_json TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wm_opc_tag_catalog (
  tag_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  equipment_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  tag_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  parameter_name VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL,
  data_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  unit VARCHAR(32),
  mes_usage VARCHAR(128),
  UNIQUE(equipment_type, tag_code)
);

source.body: {"steps": [{"type": "selectMany", "var": "rows_raw", "sql": "SELECT p.product_code, p.product_name, p.product_type, p.unit, COALESCE(pp.product_code,'') AS parent_product_code FROM wm_dict_product p LEFT JOIN wm_dict_product pp ON pp.product_id=p.parent_product_id WHERE p.is_active ORDER BY p.product_id"}, {"type": "map", "var": "rows", "source": "${rows_raw}", "fields": {"product_code": "${item.product_code}", "product_name": "${item.product_name}", "product_type": "${item.product_type}", "unit": "${item.unit}", "parent_product_code": "${item.parent_product_code}"}}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO wm_dict_product (product_code, product_name, product_type, unit, parent_product_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, (SELECT product_id FROM wm_dict_product WHERE product_code = NULLIF(?, '') LIMIT 1)) ON CONFLICT (product_code) DO UPDATE SET product_name=EXCLUDED.product_name, product_type=EXCLUDED.product_type, unit=EXCLUDED.unit, parent_product_id=EXCLUDED.parent_product_id, is_active=true", "params": ["${input.product_code}", "${input.product_name}", "${input.product_type}", "${input.unit}", "${input.parent_product_code}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO wm_audit_log(entity_type, entity_id, action, actor_role, actor_name) VALUES ('dict_product', ?, 'upsert', 'admin', ?)", "params": ["${input.product_code}", "${input.actor}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "product_code": "${input.product_code}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "ref", "sql": "SELECT COUNT(*)::text AS cnt FROM wm_shift_metric sm WHERE sm.metric_code LIKE '%' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wm_dict_product p WHERE p.product_code=?)", "params": ["${input.product_code}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE wm_dict_product SET is_active=false WHERE product_code=?", "params": ["${input.product_code}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO wm_audit_log(entity_type, entity_id, action, actor_role, actor_name) VALUES ('dict_product', ?, 'deactivate', 'admin', ?)", "params": ["${input.product_code}", "${input.actor}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": ""}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectMany", "var": "rows_raw", "sql": "SELECT equipment_tag, equipment_name, equipment_type, process_stage_code, COALESCE(line_no::text,'') AS line_no, asutp_point_id FROM wm_dict_equipment WHERE is_active ORDER BY equipment_id"}, {"type": "map", "var": "rows", "source": "${rows_raw}", "fields": {"equipment_tag": "${item.equipment_tag}", "equipment_name": "${item.equipment_name}", "equipment_type": "${item.equipment_type}", "process_stage_code": "${item.process_stage_code}", "line_no": "${item.line_no}", "asutp_point_id": "${item.asutp_point_id}"}}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectMany", "var": "rows_raw", "sql": "SELECT coefficient_code, coefficient_name, value::text AS value, COALESCE(unit,'') AS unit, COALESCE(ref_object_code,'') AS ref_object_code FROM wm_dict_coefficient WHERE is_active ORDER BY coefficient_id"}, {"type": "map", "var": "rows", "source": "${rows_raw}", "fields": {"coefficient_code": "${item.coefficient_code}", "coefficient_name": "${item.coefficient_name}", "value": "${item.value}", "unit": "${item.unit}", "ref_object_code": "${item.ref_object_code}"}}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO wm_dict_coefficient (coefficient_code, coefficient_name, value, unit, ref_object_code) VALUES (?, ?, ?::numeric, NULLIF(?,''), NULLIF(?,'')) ON CONFLICT (coefficient_code) DO UPDATE SET coefficient_name=EXCLUDED.coefficient_name, value=EXCLUDED.value, unit=EXCLUDED.unit, ref_object_code=EXCLUDED.ref_object_code, is_active=true", "params": ["${input.coefficient_code}", "${input.coefficient_name}", "${input.value}", "${input.unit}", "${input.ref_object_code}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": ""}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectMany", "var": "rows_raw", "sql": "SELECT reason_code, reason_name, reason_category FROM wm_dict_downtime_reason WHERE is_active ORDER BY reason_id"}, {"type": "map", "var": "rows", "source": "${rows_raw}", "fields": {"reason_code": "${item.reason_code}", "reason_name": "${item.reason_name}", "reason_category": "${item.reason_category}"}}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO wm_dict_downtime_reason (reason_code, reason_name, reason_category) VALUES (?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT (reason_code) DO UPDATE SET reason_name=EXCLUDED.reason_name, reason_category=EXCLUDED.reason_category, is_active=true", "params": ["${input.reason_code}", "${input.reason_name}", "${input.reason_category}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": ""}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "bucket", "sql": "SELECT value::text AS v FROM wm_dict_coefficient WHERE coefficient_code='BUCKET_VOLUME_DR1' AND is_active LIMIT 1"}, {"type": "failIfNull", "var": "bucket", "message": "BUCKET_VOLUME_DR1 not found"}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO wm_ore_receipt (work_date, shift_no, received_at, bucket_volume_m3, created_by) VALUES (?::date, ?::int, ?::timestamp, (SELECT value FROM wm_dict_coefficient WHERE coefficient_code='BUCKET_VOLUME_DR1' LIMIT 1), ?)", "params": ["${input.work_date}", "${input.shift_no}", "${input.received_at}", "${input.created_by}"]}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "tot", "sql": "SELECT COUNT(*)::text AS n, (COUNT(*) * (SELECT value FROM wm_dict_coefficient WHERE coefficient_code='BUCKET_VOLUME_DR1'))::text AS vol, (COUNT(*) * (SELECT value FROM wm_dict_coefficient WHERE coefficient_code='BUCKET_VOLUME_DR1') *  COALESCE((SELECT density_t_m3 FROM wm_lims_bulk_density WHERE work_date=?::date),  (SELECT density_t_m3 FROM wm_lims_bulk_density ORDER BY work_date DESC LIMIT 1), 0))::text AS mass FROM wm_ore_receipt WHERE work_date=?::date AND shift_no=?::int", "params": ["${input.work_date}", "${input.work_date}", "${input.shift_no}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "id": "OK", "volume_m3": "${tot.vol}", "mass_t": "${tot.mass}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "dens", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE((SELECT density_t_m3::text FROM wm_lims_bulk_density WHERE work_date=?::date),(SELECT density_t_m3::text FROM wm_lims_bulk_density ORDER BY work_date DESC LIMIT 1),'0') AS density, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wm_lims_bulk_density WHERE work_date=?::date) THEN 'false' ELSE 'true' END AS is_fallback", "params": ["${input.work_date}", "${input.work_date}"]}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "agg", "sql": "SELECT COUNT(*)::text AS n, (COUNT(*) * (SELECT value FROM wm_dict_coefficient WHERE coefficient_code='BUCKET_VOLUME_DR1'))::text AS vol FROM wm_ore_receipt WHERE work_date=?::date AND shift_no=?::int", "params": ["${input.work_date}", "${input.shift_no}"]}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "q", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(h2o_pct::text,'') AS h2o, COALESCE(sio2_pct::text,'') AS sio2, COALESCE(fe_pct::text,'') AS fe, COALESCE(co_pct::text,'') AS co FROM wm_lims_quality WHERE work_date=?::date AND shift_no=?::int AND sample_point='RAW_ORE'", "params": ["${input.work_date}", "${input.shift_no}"]}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "lims", "sql": "SELECT CASE WHEN is_healthy THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END AS ok FROM wm_integration_status WHERE source_code='LIMS'"}, {"type": "selectMany", "var": "rows_raw", "sql": "SELECT received_at::text AS received_at, bucket_volume_m3::text AS bucket_volume_m3, created_by FROM wm_ore_receipt WHERE work_date=?::date AND shift_no=?::int ORDER BY received_at", "params": ["${input.work_date}", "${input.shift_no}"]}, {"type": "map", "var": "rows", "source": "${rows_raw}", "fields": {"received_at": "${item.received_at}", "bucket_volume_m3": "${item.bucket_volume_m3}", "created_by": "${item.created_by}"}}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "mass", "sql": "SELECT (COALESCE(?::numeric,0) * COALESCE(?::numeric,0))::text AS mass", "params": ["${agg.vol}", "${dens.density}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "receipt_count": "${agg.n}", "volume_m3": "${agg.vol}", "density_t_m3": "${dens.density}", "mass_t": "${mass.mass}", "density_is_fallback": "${dens.is_fallback}", "h2o_pct": "${q.h2o}", "sio2_pct": "${q.sio2}", "fe_pct": "${q.fe}", "co_pct": "${q.co}", "quality_locked": "${lims.ok}", "rows": "${rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "reason", "sql": "SELECT reason_code FROM wm_dict_downtime_reason WHERE reason_code=? AND is_active", "params": ["${input.reason_code}"]}, {"type": "failIfNull", "var": "reason", "message": "Unknown downtime reason"}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO wm_downtime (work_date, shift_no, equipment_tag, started_at, ended_at, reason_code, comment, created_by) VALUES (?::date, ?::int, ?, ?::timestamp, ?::timestamp, ?, ?, ?)", "params": ["${input.work_date}", "${input.shift_no}", "${input.equipment_tag}", "${input.started_at}", "${input.ended_at}", "${input.reason_code}", "${input.comment}", "${input.created_by}"]}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "d", "sql": "SELECT duration_min::text AS m FROM wm_downtime WHERE work_date=?::date AND shift_no=?::int AND equipment_tag=? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1", "params": ["${input.work_date}", "${input.shift_no}", "${input.equipment_tag}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "duration_min": "${d.m}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO wm_shift_metric (work_date, shift_no, equipment_tag, metric_code, metric_value, unit, source, is_overridden, updated_by) VALUES (?::date, ?::int, ?, ?, ?::numeric, ?, ?, (? = 'true'), ?) ON CONFLICT (work_date, shift_no, equipment_tag, metric_code) DO UPDATE SET metric_value=EXCLUDED.metric_value, unit=EXCLUDED.unit, source=EXCLUDED.source, is_overridden=EXCLUDED.is_overridden, updated_by=EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at=now()", "params": ["${input.work_date}", "${input.shift_no}", "${input.equipment_tag}", "${input.metric_code}", "${input.metric_value}", "${input.unit}", "${input.source}", "${input.is_overridden}", "${input.updated_by}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO wm_audit_log(entity_type, entity_id, action, actor_role, actor_name, payload_json) VALUES ('shift_metric', ?, 'upsert', ?, ?, ?)", "params": ["${input.equipment_tag}", "${input.actor_role}", "${input.updated_by}", "${input.metric_code}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": ""}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO wm_flowmeter_hourly (work_date, shift_no, hour_index, q_m3h) VALUES (?::date, ?::int, ?::int, ?::numeric) ON CONFLICT (work_date, shift_no, hour_index, equipment_tag, tag_code) DO UPDATE SET q_m3h=EXCLUDED.q_m3h, captured_at=now()", "params": ["${input.work_date}", "${input.shift_no}", "${input.hour_index}", "${input.q_m3h}"]}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "sum", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(q_m3h),0)::text AS v FROM wm_flowmeter_hourly WHERE work_date=?::date AND shift_no=?::int AND equipment_tag='SG-1'", "params": ["${input.work_date}", "${input.shift_no}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO wm_shift_metric (work_date, shift_no, equipment_tag, metric_code, metric_value, unit, source, is_overridden) VALUES (?::date, ?::int, 'SG-1', 'SHIFT_VOLUME_M3', ?::numeric, 'm3', 'opc_agg', false) ON CONFLICT (work_date, shift_no, equipment_tag, metric_code) DO UPDATE SET metric_value = CASE WHEN wm_shift_metric.is_overridden THEN wm_shift_metric.metric_value ELSE EXCLUDED.metric_value END, updated_at=now()", "params": ["${input.work_date}", "${input.shift_no}", "${sum.v}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "shift_volume_m3": "${sum.v}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectMany", "var": "rows_raw", "sql": "SELECT hour_index::text AS hour_index, q_m3h::text AS q_m3h, captured_at::text AS captured_at FROM wm_flowmeter_hourly WHERE work_date=?::date AND shift_no=?::int AND equipment_tag='SG-1' ORDER BY hour_index", "params": ["${input.work_date}", "${input.shift_no}"]}, {"type": "map", "var": "rows", "source": "${rows_raw}", "fields": {"hour_index": "${item.hour_index}", "q_m3h": "${item.q_m3h}", "captured_at": "${item.captured_at}"}}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "sum", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(q_m3h),0)::text AS v FROM wm_flowmeter_hourly WHERE work_date=?::date AND shift_no=?::int", "params": ["${input.work_date}", "${input.shift_no}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "shift_volume_m3": "${sum.v}", "rows": "${rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "lims", "sql": "SELECT CASE WHEN is_healthy THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END AS ok FROM wm_integration_status WHERE source_code='LIMS'"}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO wm_lims_quality (work_date, shift_no, sample_point, h2o_pct, sio2_pct, fe_pct, co_pct, source) VALUES (?::date, ?::int, ?, ?::numeric, ?::numeric, ?::numeric, ?::numeric, ?) ON CONFLICT (work_date, shift_no, sample_point) DO UPDATE SET h2o_pct=EXCLUDED.h2o_pct, sio2_pct=EXCLUDED.sio2_pct, fe_pct=EXCLUDED.fe_pct, co_pct=EXCLUDED.co_pct, source=EXCLUDED.source", "params": ["${input.work_date}", "${input.shift_no}", "${input.sample_point}", "${input.h2o_pct}", "${input.sio2_pct}", "${input.fe_pct}", "${input.co_pct}", "${input.source}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": ""}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO wm_lims_bulk_density (work_date, density_t_m3, source, is_fallback) VALUES (?::date, ?::numeric, ?, (?='true')) ON CONFLICT (work_date) DO UPDATE SET density_t_m3=EXCLUDED.density_t_m3, source=EXCLUDED.source, is_fallback=EXCLUDED.is_fallback", "params": ["${input.work_date}", "${input.density_t_m3}", "${input.source}", "${input.is_fallback}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE wm_integration_status SET is_healthy=true, last_success_at=now(), updated_at=now() WHERE source_code='LIMS'"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": ""}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO wm_integration_status (source_code, is_healthy, last_error, last_success_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, (?='true'), NULLIF(?,''), CASE WHEN ?='true' THEN now() ELSE NULL END, now()) ON CONFLICT (source_code) DO UPDATE SET is_healthy=EXCLUDED.is_healthy, last_error=EXCLUDED.last_error, last_success_at=CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.is_healthy THEN now() ELSE wm_integration_status.last_success_at END, updated_at=now()", "params": ["${input.source_code}", "${input.is_healthy}", "${input.last_error}", "${input.is_healthy}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": ""}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectMany", "var": "mraw", "sql": "SELECT metric_code, metric_value::text AS metric_value, COALESCE(unit,'') AS unit, source, CASE WHEN is_overridden THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END AS is_overridden FROM wm_shift_metric WHERE work_date=?::date AND shift_no=?::int AND equipment_tag=?", "params": ["${input.work_date}", "${input.shift_no}", "${input.equipment_tag}"]}, {"type": "map", "var": "metrics", "source": "${mraw}", "fields": {"metric_code": "${item.metric_code}", "metric_value": "${item.metric_value}", "unit": "${item.unit}", "source": "${item.source}", "is_overridden": "${item.is_overridden}"}}, {"type": "selectMany", "var": "draw", "sql": "SELECT started_at::text, ended_at::text, reason_code, COALESCE(comment,'') AS comment, duration_min::text AS duration_min FROM wm_downtime WHERE work_date=?::date AND shift_no=?::int AND equipment_tag=? ORDER BY started_at", "params": ["${input.work_date}", "${input.shift_no}", "${input.equipment_tag}"]}, {"type": "map", "var": "downtimes", "source": "${draw}", "fields": {"started_at": "${item.started_at}", "ended_at": "${item.ended_at}", "reason_code": "${item.reason_code}", "comment": "${item.comment}", "duration_min": "${item.duration_min}"}}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "util", "sql": "SELECT ROUND(((480 - COALESCE(SUM(duration_min),0)) / 480.0 * 100)::numeric, 1)::text AS pct FROM wm_downtime WHERE work_date=?::date AND shift_no=?::int AND equipment_tag=?", "params": ["${input.work_date}", "${input.shift_no}", "${input.equipment_tag}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "metrics": "${metrics}", "downtimes": "${downtimes}", "utilization_pct": "${util.pct}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "ore", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.bucket_volume_m3 * COALESCE(d.density_t_m3, (SELECT density_t_m3 FROM wm_lims_bulk_density b WHERE b.work_date <= r.work_date ORDER BY b.work_date DESC LIMIT 1), 0)),0)::text AS mass FROM wm_ore_receipt r LEFT JOIN wm_lims_bulk_density d ON d.work_date=r.work_date WHERE r.work_date BETWEEN ?::date AND ?::date", "params": ["${input.date_from}", "${input.date_to}"]}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "crush", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(metric_value),0)::text AS v FROM wm_shift_metric WHERE equipment_tag IN ('DR-2','DR-3') AND metric_code='THROUGHPUT_T' AND work_date BETWEEN ?::date AND ?::date", "params": ["${input.date_from}", "${input.date_to}"]}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "screen", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(metric_value),0)::text AS v FROM wm_shift_metric WHERE equipment_tag IN ('GR-1','GR-2') AND metric_code='FEED_T' AND work_date BETWEEN ?::date AND ?::date", "params": ["${input.date_from}", "${input.date_to}"]}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "pulp", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(metric_value),0)::text AS v FROM wm_shift_metric WHERE equipment_tag='GC-1' AND metric_code='PULP_VOLUME_M3' AND work_date BETWEEN ?::date AND ?::date", "params": ["${input.date_from}", "${input.date_to}"]}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "rec", "sql": "SELECT (COALESCE((SELECT SUM(metric_value) FROM wm_shift_metric WHERE equipment_tag='GC-1' AND metric_code='PULP_VOLUME_M3' AND work_date BETWEEN ?::date AND ?::date),0)  * (SELECT value FROM wm_dict_coefficient WHERE coefficient_code='RECOVERY_FACTOR_GC1'))::text AS v", "params": ["${input.date_from}", "${input.date_to}"]}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "prod", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN m.metric_code='SHIFT_VOLUME_M3' THEN m.metric_value * COALESCE(d.metric_value, (SELECT value FROM wm_dict_coefficient WHERE coefficient_code='DENSITY_PROD_SG1'), 1.62) ELSE 0 END),0)::text AS mass FROM wm_shift_metric m LEFT JOIN wm_shift_metric d ON d.work_date=m.work_date AND d.shift_no=m.shift_no AND d.equipment_tag='SG-1' AND d.metric_code='OUTPUT_DENSITY' WHERE m.equipment_tag='SG-1' AND m.metric_code='SHIFT_VOLUME_M3' AND m.work_date BETWEEN ?::date AND ?::date", "params": ["${input.date_from}", "${input.date_to}"]}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "dt", "sql": "SELECT COUNT(*)::text AS cases, COALESCE(SUM(duration_min),0)::text AS mins FROM wm_downtime WHERE work_date BETWEEN ?::date AND ?::date", "params": ["${input.date_from}", "${input.date_to}"]}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "util", "sql": "SELECT ROUND(((5*3*480 - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(duration_min) FROM wm_downtime WHERE work_date BETWEEN ?::date AND ?::date AND equipment_tag IN ('DR-2','DR-3','GR-1','GR-2','GC-1')),0))  / (5.0*3*480) * 100)::numeric, 1)::text AS pct", "params": ["${input.date_from}", "${input.date_to}"]}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "oq", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(AVG(fe_pct),0)::text AS fe, COALESCE(AVG(sio2_pct),0)::text AS sio2, COALESCE(AVG(h2o_pct),0)::text AS h2o FROM wm_lims_quality WHERE sample_point='RAW_ORE' AND work_date BETWEEN ?::date AND ?::date", "params": ["${input.date_from}", "${input.date_to}"]}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "pq", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(AVG(fe_pct),0)::text AS fe, COALESCE(AVG(sio2_pct),0)::text AS sio2, COALESCE(AVG(h2o_pct),0)::text AS h2o FROM wm_lims_quality WHERE sample_point='PRODUCT' AND work_date BETWEEN ?::date AND ?::date", "params": ["${input.date_from}", "${input.date_to}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "ore_mass_t": "${ore.mass}", "crush_t": "${crush.v}", "screen_t": "${screen.v}", "pulp_m3": "${pulp.v}", "gc_recovery_m3": "${rec.v}", "product_mass_t": "${prod.mass}", "downtime_cases": "${dt.cases}", "downtime_min": "${dt.mins}", "utilization_pct": "${util.pct}", "ore_fe": "${oq.fe}", "ore_sio2": "${oq.sio2}", "ore_h2o": "${oq.h2o}", "prod_fe": "${pq.fe}", "prod_sio2": "${pq.sio2}", "prod_h2o": "${pq.h2o}"}}]}

reports.title: Сменный отчёт ДР-1
reports.query:
SELECT r.work_date::text AS work_date, r.shift_no,
              COUNT(*) AS receipt_count,
              (COUNT(*) * (SELECT value FROM wm_dict_coefficient WHERE coefficient_code='BUCKET_VOLUME_DR1')) AS volume_m3,
              COALESCE(d.density_t_m3, (SELECT density_t_m3 FROM wm_lims_bulk_density ORDER BY work_date DESC LIMIT 1)) AS density,
              (COUNT(*) * (SELECT value FROM wm_dict_coefficient WHERE coefficient_code='BUCKET_VOLUME_DR1') *
               COALESCE(d.density_t_m3, (SELECT density_t_m3 FROM wm_lims_bulk_density ORDER BY work_date DESC LIMIT 1))) AS mass_t,
              q.h2o_pct, q.fe_pct, q.sio2_pct
           FROM wm_ore_receipt r
           LEFT JOIN wm_lims_bulk_density d ON d.work_date=r.work_date
           LEFT JOIN wm_lims_quality q ON q.work_date=r.work_date AND q.shift_no=r.shift_no AND q.sample_point='RAW_ORE'
           GROUP BY r.work_date, r.shift_no, d.density_t_m3, q.h2o_pct, q.fe_pct, q.sio2_pct
           ORDER BY r.work_date DESC, r.shift_no

reports.title: Сменный отчёт ДР-2 / ДР-3
reports.query:
SELECT m.work_date::text AS work_date, m.shift_no, m.equipment_tag, m.metric_value AS throughput_t,
              COALESCE(dt.cnt,0) AS downtime_cases, COALESCE(dt.mins,0) AS downtime_min,
              ROUND(((480 - COALESCE(dt.mins,0)) / 480.0 * 100)::numeric,1) AS utilization_pct
           FROM wm_shift_metric m
           LEFT JOIN (
             SELECT work_date, shift_no, equipment_tag, COUNT(*) cnt, SUM(duration_min) mins
             FROM wm_downtime GROUP BY work_date, shift_no, equipment_tag
           ) dt ON dt.work_date=m.work_date AND dt.shift_no=m.shift_no AND dt.equipment_tag=m.equipment_tag
           WHERE m.equipment_tag IN ('DR-2','DR-3') AND m.metric_code='THROUGHPUT_T'
           ORDER BY m.work_date DESC, m.shift_no, m.equipment_tag

reports.title: Сменный отчёт ГР-1 / ГР-2
reports.query:
SELECT m.work_date::text AS work_date, m.shift_no, m.equipment_tag, m.metric_value AS feed_t,
              ov.metric_value AS oversize_pct,
              COALESCE(dt.mins,0) AS downtime_min,
              ROUND(((480 - COALESCE(dt.mins,0)) / 480.0 * 100)::numeric,1) AS utilization_pct
           FROM wm_shift_metric m
           LEFT JOIN wm_shift_metric ov ON ov.work_date=m.work_date AND ov.shift_no=m.shift_no AND ov.equipment_tag=m.equipment_tag AND ov.metric_code='OVERSIZE_PCT'
           LEFT JOIN (
             SELECT work_date, shift_no, equipment_tag, SUM(duration_min) mins FROM wm_downtime GROUP BY 1,2,3
           ) dt ON dt.work_date=m.work_date AND dt.shift_no=m.shift_no AND dt.equipment_tag=m.equipment_tag
           WHERE m.equipment_tag IN ('GR-1','GR-2') AND m.metric_code='FEED_T'
           ORDER BY m.work_date DESC, m.shift_no, m.equipment_tag

reports.title: Сменный отчёт ГЦ-1
reports.query:
SELECT m.work_date::text AS work_date, m.shift_no, m.metric_value AS pulp_m3,
              od.metric_value AS overflow_density, ud.metric_value AS underflow_density,
              (m.metric_value * (SELECT value FROM wm_dict_coefficient WHERE coefficient_code='RECOVERY_FACTOR_GC1')) AS recovery_m3,
              COALESCE(dt.mins,0) AS downtime_min
           FROM wm_shift_metric m
           LEFT JOIN wm_shift_metric od ON od.work_date=m.work_date AND od.shift_no=m.shift_no AND od.equipment_tag='GC-1' AND od.metric_code='OVERFLOW_DENSITY'
           LEFT JOIN wm_shift_metric ud ON ud.work_date=m.work_date AND ud.shift_no=m.shift_no AND ud.equipment_tag='GC-1' AND ud.metric_code='UNDERFLOW_DENSITY'
           LEFT JOIN (SELECT work_date, shift_no, SUM(duration_min) mins FROM wm_downtime WHERE equipment_tag='GC-1' GROUP BY 1,2) dt
             ON dt.work_date=m.work_date AND dt.shift_no=m.shift_no
           WHERE m.equipment_tag='GC-1' AND m.metric_code='PULP_VOLUME_M3'
           ORDER BY m.work_date DESC, m.shift_no

reports.title: Сменный отчёт СГ-1
reports.query:
SELECT m.work_date::text AS work_date, m.shift_no, m.metric_value AS shift_volume_m3,
              dens.metric_value AS density,
              (m.metric_value * COALESCE(dens.metric_value, (SELECT value FROM wm_dict_coefficient WHERE coefficient_code='DENSITY_PROD_SG1'))) AS mass_t,
              q.h2o_pct, q.fe_pct, q.sio2_pct
           FROM wm_shift_metric m
           LEFT JOIN wm_shift_metric dens ON dens.work_date=m.work_date AND dens.shift_no=m.shift_no AND dens.equipment_tag='SG-1' AND dens.metric_code='OUTPUT_DENSITY'
           LEFT JOIN wm_lims_quality q ON q.work_date=m.work_date AND q.shift_no=m.shift_no AND q.sample_point='PRODUCT'
           WHERE m.equipment_tag='SG-1' AND m.metric_code='SHIFT_VOLUME_M3'
           ORDER BY m.work_date DESC, m.shift_no

reports.title: Сводный отчёт по цеху
reports.query:
SELECT 'plant' AS scope,
              (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.bucket_volume_m3 * COALESCE(d.density_t_m3,2.1)),0) FROM wm_ore_receipt r LEFT JOIN wm_lims_bulk_density d ON d.work_date=r.work_date) AS ore_mass_t,
              (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(metric_value),0) FROM wm_shift_metric WHERE equipment_tag IN ('DR-2','DR-3') AND metric_code='THROUGHPUT_T') AS crush_t,
              (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(metric_value),0) FROM wm_shift_metric WHERE equipment_tag IN ('GR-1','GR-2') AND metric_code='FEED_T') AS screen_t,
              (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(metric_value),0) FROM wm_shift_metric WHERE equipment_tag='GC-1' AND metric_code='PULP_VOLUME_M3') AS pulp_m3,
              (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(metric_value),0) * (SELECT value FROM wm_dict_coefficient WHERE coefficient_code='RECOVERY_FACTOR_GC1')
                 FROM wm_shift_metric WHERE equipment_tag='GC-1' AND metric_code='PULP_VOLUME_M3') AS gc_recovery_m3,
              (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wm_downtime) AS downtime_cases,
              (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(duration_min),0) FROM wm_downtime) AS downtime_min

SELECT COALESCE((
          SELECT COUNT(*) * (SELECT value FROM wm_dict_coefficient WHERE coefficient_code='BUCKET_VOLUME_DR1') *
                 COALESCE((SELECT density_t_m3 FROM wm_lims_bulk_density ORDER BY work_date DESC LIMIT 1), 2.1)
          FROM wm_ore_receipt WHERE work_date=(SELECT MAX(work_date) FROM wm_ore_receipt)
            AND shift_no=(SELECT MAX(shift_no) FROM wm_ore_receipt WHERE work_date=(SELECT MAX(work_date) FROM wm_ore_receipt))
        ),0)::float8 AS v

    <serviceTask id="agg" name="Агрегация FT-4"
                 ispf:action="invoke_function"
                 ispf:objectPath="root.platform.devices.mes-wrangel-hub"
                 ispf:functionName="wm_captureFlowmeterHour"/>
    <serviceTask id="kpi" name="Обновить KPI"
                 ispf:action="invoke_function"
                 ispf:objectPath="root.platform.devices.mes-wrangel-hub"
                 ispf:functionName="wm_refreshHubKpis"/>
    <endEvent id="end" name="Смена закрыта"/>
    <sequenceFlow sourceRef="start" targetRef="agg"/>
    <sequenceFlow sourceRef="agg" targetRef="kpi"/>
    <sequenceFlow sourceRef="kpi" targetRef="end"/>
  </process>
</definitions>
